fixture.topology: One autonomous three-phase voltage source. Ground the common source and Y-load neutral. Each phase passes through its own R–L feeder to the PCC. Connect a 120 ohm baseline resistor and a second switched resistor in parallel from each PCC phase to neutral.
fixture.conventions: Source and PCC voltages are phase to neutral. Feeder current is positive toward the PCC. Both load currents are positive from the PCC to neutral. PCC power is the sum of three solved voltage-current products, in watts.

controller.rules: At t=0 record the parked controller and zero source amplitude. Use the initial 60 Hz to advance the first interval. At positive row k the already scheduled phase and magnitude drive the source. Recalculate PCC power from the solved row, update the backward-Euler power filter, compute f_k = 60 - .001*(P_filtered_k - 360), then set phase_(k+1) = phase_k + 2*pi*h*f_k. The load resistance is 120 ohm from the exact 0.200 s row onward. Record source phase without wrapping.

implementation.entry_point: Use the public CaseDefinition/Circuit/Simulator path with the existing controlled voltage, resistor, inductor and time-controlled switch components.
implementation.initial_state: Each feeder current and the applied phase starts at zero. Hold the source at zero amplitude at the initial row. Initialize filtered power to 360 W and frequency to 60 Hz.
implementation.step_order: The source callback reads the angle scheduled by the previous solved row. At the initial row advance phase by one interval at the parked frequency. At positive rows update filtered power and frequency from same-row measured PCC voltage and feeder current, then schedule the next angle. Stamping the source must not mutate controller state.
implementation.load_change: Switch the added Y load in the exact 0.200 s electrical row. Keep the frozen resistance between that PCC phase and ground; base load remains connected.
implementation.solver: Fixed-grid trapezoidal integration. Record every row including zero and the final 0.400 s row.

same_grid.rationale: The original grid and matched-start probe represent the same electrical circuit and controller. Preserve exact event words and tight SI comparisons with margin for native text precision and floating-point arithmetic.

completion: Publish only after independent raw PSCAD comparison at both original grids, full circuit and controller checks, standalone runs, figure and report, tests, beginner explanation and Git acceptance.
